title: Decide and document the destination metadata rule for standalone imported acceptance and already-consumed imported proof
outcome: Decide and document the destination metadata rule for standalone imported acceptance and already-consumed imported proof
acceptance: One rule states which destination metadata must match when an imported acceptance is used standalone and when an already-consumed imported proof is reused (src/work_service/evaluate/evaluation.rs:33 and completion/imported.rs:257 today apply different strictness), and the code applies that one rule in both places
A behaviour test through the public words shows both paths accept and refuse the same metadata cases
